teasers.title: Automatic source scan
teasers.detail: Public sources are checked by the scheduled monitor; the site polls this snapshot every 5 seconds.

teasers.title: Evidence-first status
teasers.detail: The dashboard avoids treating an unverified teaser, rumor, or test claim as confirmed.

teasers.title: More public details can appear
teasers.detail: When a checked source changes, the next snapshot can update the dashboard.
